description: 1941 is the Year of the Metal Snake in the Chinese zodiac, from January 27, 1941 to February 14, 1942. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1941 is the Year of the Metal Snake, a Yin year. It began at Lunar New Year on January 27, 1941 and ended on February 14, 1942, so people born in 1941 before Jan 27 belong to the Metal Dragon year.

sections.heading: When the 1941 Metal Snake year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1941 Metal Snake year began at Lunar New Year on January 27, 1941 and lasted until February 14, 1942, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Jan 27 1941 therefore belongs to the Metal Dragon year that started in 1940, while someone born in early 1942, up to Feb 14, is still a Metal Snake. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Metal Snake combination also falls in 2001, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1941 fell on a Monday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Metal Snake personality
paragraphs: A Metal Snake year is linked with sharp-minded, self-possessed and strategic people. The Snake's Fire shapes Metal like a smith at a forge, so traditional readings describe insight refined into precise purpose. Those born then often have exacting taste and remarkable persistence. The usual caution is coolness or secrecy, which earlier sharing of plans tends to ease. Their patience can outlast almost any obstacle.

Metal is the element of autumn and harvest, and a Metal year is traditionally said to sharpen whatever animal it meets. Descriptions associate it with determination, discipline, clear judgement and a strong code of principle. Metal-year people are often portrayed as decisive, self-reliant and willing to do difficult things because they are right. The element is linked with refinement and with cutting away what is unnecessary, so it tends to bring focus and high standards. Its traditional shadow is rigidity: Metal can become inflexible, proud or emotionally guarded, preferring to be correct over being close, and finding it hard to bend once a position is taken.

sections.heading: 1941 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the year's digits come to 6, linked with home, care and responsibility, so a 6 year is read as one centred on family and commitments. The digits of 1941 add up to 15, which reduces to 6. In the twelve-year cycle the Snake is the sixth animal, earthly branch Si, with Fire as its fixed element and Yin polarity. The year element is Metal, and in the five-element cycles fire controls Metal. The year before was the Metal Dragon and the year after is the Water Horse.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Xin-Si: Xin is the Metal heavenly stem and Si is the Snake's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yin stems only ever meet yin animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1941?
faq.answer: 1941 is the Year of the Metal Snake. It started on January 27, 1941 and ended on February 14, 1942.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1941?
faq.answer: Check the date against Jan 27. Born before January 27, 1941, you are a Metal Dragon; born on or after it, you are a Metal Snake.

faq.question: What element is 1941 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Metal, a Yin year. The Snake's own fixed element is Fire; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1941?
faq.answer: Xin-Si. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Metal Snake year?
faq.answer: 2001, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 2001.
